children: ICICI Securities's research report on Indiqube Spaces

Indiqube Spaces Ltd. (Indiqube) delivered a strong Q2FY27 result on the back of mature centre occupancy rising 100bps QoQ to 91%. Hence, Q2FY27 revenue was up 12% QoQ with IGAAP EBITDA (cash EBIT) up 39% QoQ to INR 1bn at an IGAAP EBITDA margin of 22% (up 430bps QoQ) owing to higher VAS margins of 20%. For the remainder of FY27, management is confident that growth momentum would sustain, with 1–1.5msf of new area becoming operational. We build in a 26% revenue CAGR and 32% IGAAP EBITDA CAGR over FY26–28E. We retain BUY with a revised TP of INR 271 (earlier INR 263) at 15x Sep’27E EV/EBITDA, as we raise our FY27–28E EBITDA by 2%, factoring in higher IGAAP EBITDA margin. Key risks: Office leasing slowdown and pricing pressures.
